shared_capacity_wait_body: ${address} cannot begin a work period because shared capacity is unavailable. ${instruction} Trying again will not clear this pause.
shared_capacity_wait_instruction_timed: Operations will reconsider after the recorded wait.
shared_capacity_wait_instruction_owner: The owner must restore the shared service.
shared_dependency_paused_body_timed: Shared ${scope} ${dependency}: ${kind}. Incident ${incident_id}. Wait until UTC epoch ${until}; reset permits another attempt, not guaranteed quota.
shared_dependency_paused_body_owner: Shared ${scope} ${dependency}: ${kind}. Incident ${incident_id}. Owner intervention is required.
subscription_limit_warning_body: Provider account ${account_id} reports ${status} for the ${window} usage window. The reported reset is UTC epoch ${resets_at}.
owner_mandate_revision_body: The owner revised your mandate to revision ${revision}. ${explanation}
delivery_bounce: Message ${message_id} could not be delivered because recipient ${employee_id} retired. Other deliveries are unchanged.
level_default: The level chooser failed for ${address}. Failed assessments: ${attempts}. Last reason: ${reason}. The employee starts at the default level, ${model_class} class at ${effort} effort. Route the role to change it.
held: ${address} is held: ${reason}. Recovery revision ${episode}. Request an authorized retry after review. If retained context is unusable, the owner can use `firm route --fresh` on the current profile before authorizing retry; routing discards the conversation but preserves the attempt budget.
github_repository_created:
${address} created the private GitHub repository ${repository} and has write access to it. Purpose: ${purpose}

For information; no action is needed. Withdraw the repository with firm github revoke, and give it back with firm github grant.
mac_needs_recovery_purpose: Every free desktop on the Mac needs its cleanup verified after an earlier lease (firm-sandbox mac-recover). Answered when the runtime sees it recovered; otherwise grant it once the Mac is ready.
mac_not_enrolled_purpose: The Mac has no desktop account set up (firm-sandbox mac-prepare in an enrollment firm). Grant this once enrollment is finished.
mac_session_not_ready_purpose: No desktop account on the Mac is ready for a lease. Check the desktop accounts, then grant this.
access_granted: The owner granted your request for ${resource}. It is available now; nothing needs restarting. If a tool refused you meanwhile, call it again.
access_denied:
The owner declined your request for ${resource}. Reason: ${reason}

Do not ask for it again; work without it or tell your manager what you could not do.
